meta.title: 如何让你的街拍充满时尚感？
meta.title_en: How to Make Your Street Photos Look Fashionable
meta.topic: 街拍 · 构图与姿势口令

scenes.context: 正面平拍是错误示范，正确的做法是侧位站位、机位举高、避开白色背景。
sentences: 你信不信这个时段很出片。
Believe it or not, this time of day is great for photos.
this time of day（这个时段）
你这么拍肯定是不行的。
Shooting like this definitely won't work.
won't work（不行/没效果）
到我的侧面，不要拍到后面那些白色的景。
Stand at my side, and don't capture that white background.
at my side（在侧面）
paraphrase: Keep the white scenery out of the frame.
scenes.speak: Believe it or not, this time of day is great for photos. Shooting like this definitely won't work. Stand at my side, and don't capture that white background.

scenes.context: 头顶不留太多空间；把地面放进画面让构图一分为二；远离杂景保证纯背景。
sentences: 不用给我的头留太多的空间。
Don't leave too much space above my head.
headroom（头顶空间）
画面是不是一分为二了。
The frame is split right in two now, isn't it?
split in two（一分为二）
纯粹的背景板才能出大片。
Only a clean backdrop makes a great shot.
clean backdrop（纯背景板）
paraphrase: Use the ground line to divide the composition.
That's how you nail a banger photo.
scenes.speak: Don't leave too much space above my head. The frame is split right in two now, isn't it? Only a clean backdrop makes a great shot.

scenes.context: 倒肩伸手、半身构图头顶放右上角，垮包看侧方等风吹出松弛酷感。
sentences: 倒个肩膀，伸手。
Tilt your shoulder, reach out your hand.
tilt your shoulder（侧肩）
尽量把我的头顶在你的右上角。
Try to place the top of my head at the upper-right corner.
upper-right corner（右上角）
拍着那种松弛酷酷的感觉。
Capture that relaxed, cool vibe.
relaxed vibe（松弛感）
paraphrase: Frame me from the waist up.
Wait for the breeze to catch the shot.
scenes.speak: Tilt your shoulder, reach out your hand. Try to place the top of my head at the upper-right corner. Capture that relaxed, cool vibe.

scenes.context: 男生也适用的拍法：侧面高角度、半身留给背景、尽量不看镜头。
sentences: 把相机转过来。
Turn the camera around.
turn around（转过来）
到我侧面，高角度拍我。
Come to my side and shoot me from a high angle.
high angle（高角度）
尽量不要看镜头。
Try not to look at the camera.
look at the camera（看镜头）
paraphrase: Leave half the frame to the background.
It feels more relaxed and natural.
scenes.speak: Turn the camera around. Come to my side and shoot me from a high angle. Try not to look at the camera.

practice: It looks flat and boring — better to shoot from the side.
Put the ground line into the bottom of the frame.
半身构图头应该放哪里？
Place the top of the head near the upper-right corner.
Give the subject a natural action, like looking to the side, and avoid the lens.
pitfalls: Move to the subject's side and raise the camera.
Head-on shots look flat; an angle adds depth and style.
Leave a little headroom but not too much.
No headroom feels cramped; too much looks empty.
Keep whatever is in the background.
Look for a clean backdrop and reposition.
Clutter like drains or white walls ruins the frame.
Ask the subject to smile on cue.
Specific cues like 'tilt your shoulder' produce natural looks.
shifts: 以前正面直拍对着镜头
现在侧位站位、机位举高
以前背景有什么拍什么
现在先做背景减法、保证纯背景
以前靠被拍者自由发挥
现在给具体姿势口令，用动作带出松弛感
